text: Sebastian Cooper Hoffman's week, 2010-W09, was flagged due to his unusually high number of visits to job-search sites, with 45 visits. This is significantly above his typical range of 27.50, and even higher than the highest number of visits he had in the prior 12 weeks. Moreover, his activity is far above the range of his peers in the same role, with 91 peers averaging only 1 visit to job-search sites this week.
